units.titles: Arbitrary contract call allows attackers to steal ERC20 from users' wallets
units.known_address_notes: Same engagement as P25-0238 (Code4rena 2021-10-tally, Tally Swap / Swap.sol; this finding is the arbitrary-call -> ERC20 theft issue). Same evidence ceiling: audited source is public in code-423n4/2021-10-tally but no deployment address, deploy script or address book exists in the repo, and Taho (ex-Tally) no longer ships a Tally-owned swap contract. PARTIAL.

units.titles: Fees can be bypassed by 99.99% by setting the last hop's ratioBps to 1
units.known_address_notes: Same engagement as P25-0241 (finding 'ratioBps=1 last hop' is issue H-x of the same PDF, scope subdialia/smart-contracts-audit-v1 @1d4d3052). No address in report and no address book at docs.terrace.fi; app host terrace.fi is DNS-dead. PARTIAL - project and audited repo identified, deployed router instance not published.

units.titles: Missing access control in admin_withdraw_all_swap_fee operation
units.known_address_notes: Identity fixed: ThreeS = Chromia DEX (Cantina competition 'colorpool-chromia'), scope repo cantina-competitions/chromia-dex-sc (Rell/Cairo-style Chromia dapp, 175 files). Repo README only documents deployment to testnet (node0.testnet-asgard.chromia.com) with placeholders <YOUR_RID>; chromia.yml carries local/test blockchain RIDs only. Chromia mainnet explorer (explorer.chromia.com) is a JS SPA with no address/contract search reachable from here, so no mainnet dapp blockchain RID or contract nam
